claims: Antigua is in the Leeward Islands.
English is the official language of Antigua.
St. John's is the capital city of Antigua.
Nelson's Dockyard is located in English Harbour.
Nelson's Dockyard is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Betty’s Hope is an 18th-century sugar plantation.
The Museum of Antigua and Barbuda is in St. John's.
Sandals Grande Antigua Resort & Spa is located on Dickenson Bay.
Antigua was colonized by the British in 1638.
Antigua became an independent nation in 1981.
Antigua remains part of the Commonwealth.
